newsitem.title: USA: Danskin to appeal delisting of shares.
newsitem.headline: Danskin to appeal delisting of shares.

text.p: Danskin Inc said on Tuesday that it is seeking review of Nasdaq's decision to delist its common stock from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market for its non-compliance with Nasdaq's minimum capital and surplus requirement.
Pending completion of such review, Danskin's common stock will continue to be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, the company said.
If the company were no longer listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, it would likely trade in the over-the-counter market, Danskin said.
Danskin said it is working with Wasserstein Perella and Co Inc to provide liquidity and to enhance the company's financial position.
